"" err $HOME is not defined
"/home/u" ok /home/u/.super-star-trek/config.json
"/home/u/" ok /home/u/.super-star-trek/config.json
"/a//b/./c/../d" ok /a/b/d/.super-star-trek/config.json
"rel/dir" ok rel/dir/.super-star-trek/config.json
"." ok .super-star-trek/config.json
"/" ok /.super-star-trek/config.json
"~" ok ~/.super-star-trek/config.json
"/x y/z" ok /x y/z/.super-star-trek/config.json
